design: Hand-authored synthetic feasibility sample. Family-disjoint development and heldout_style splits. Translations share a family and split. No fitting or threshold search. Gold review cases are excluded from binary metrics and reported separately. Not validated, representative, independently annotated or calibrated for this task.
score_meaning: Model yes-option score conditional on the supplied question and options; not an offender probability or a probability of abuse.
review_policy: Scores in the inclusive [0.35,0.65] band, invalid input, or inference errors abstain to human review. Outside this band scores are provisional content triage only; high scores never establish offender identity. Report forced binary and selective metrics separately.
